name: Maple Dijon Bacon-Wrapped Salmon with Roasted Asparagus
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil (for easier cleanup).
Wash and dry asparagus. Snap (or cut) off woody ends and arrange on one half of the prepared baking sheet. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; set aside.
Place maple syrup and Dijon in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on the cutting board. Holding the tail end firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin). Discard the skin.
Cut salmon into portions. Spread half of the sauce over the salmon, then wrap with bacon. Spread remaining sauce over the bacon, then arrange, seam-side down, on the other side of the baking sheet.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until salmon is cooked through and asparagus is tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and transfer asparagus to a plate; cover with aluminum foil.
Change the oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. Return salmon to the oven and broil until bacon is crispy, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide salmon and asparagus between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
